notes: BETA 2.29.92. AMS2 (thanks simboh44): the spotter and radar no longer swap left and right; qualifying vs race and standing vs rolling start now follow the game's race state (no early 'go go go' or fake race end); safety car / full course yellow is called, and green after it; track limits only when the game deletes your lap or gives a penalty (AMS2 does not share the warning count); position, gaps and traffic now work per class. Push-to-talk: if your wheel button only sends a short pulse, a quick tap now starts listening - talk, then tap again to send (max 10 s); holding works as before. The engineer talks less: car ahead / behind calls at most once a lap in practice and qualifying, and the same message at most once in five minutes (no more 'Clear air both ways' every 28 s). NEW radar overlay (switch 'Radar' next to Overlay HUD) shows the cars around you. Also in this beta (already in stable 2.29.3): a much faster spotter, corners fixed on 47 tracks, LMU/rF2 spotter sides fixed, speech recognition no longer crashes when your Windows user name has accents, the voice falls back to the default device when the chosen output is missing, and no more 'Error creating window handle' with wheels. Not tested with the real games yet - please report on Discord, especially AMS2 left/right and whether the AMS2 track map looks mirrored.
